load_extended_coco_dataset: load a COCO annotation JSON file into Detectron2 dataset dict format with image root and optional dataset name
convert_coco_text_to_detection: convert a COCOText style JSON file to COCODetection format with optional set type filtering and minimum image size
create_inmemory_coco: create an InMemoryCOCO object from a preloaded JSON dict to avoid repeated file I/O when converting formats
extract_archive_to_image_root: extract one or more tar.gz archive files into a target image directory with strip components
validate_bbox_annotations: validate horizontal or rotated bounding box annotations against image dimensions and filter invalid ones
